'''2017 Texas Mini Worlds Mike Richards LS This Is Getting Out Of Hand''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mike Richards]] at [[2017 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Mike Richards]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 Texas Mini Worlds]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open This Is Getting Out Of Hand Richard.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2017-texas-mini-worlds/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210125014806/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2017-texas-mini-worlds/ Internet Archive]
